name: hero
title: mnml at a glance
flow: The editor, an agent session beside it and a shell below it; the shell runs git, the Jira pane is one tab away, and the palette finds a new session in a keystroke.

name: palette
title: The command palette
flow: Every command has a palette row: the palette filters as you type, Ctrl+P finds a file, and the theme picker previews NvChad's themes live.

name: splits
title: Splits and tabs
flow: Split the editor right and down, open a file in each split, then start a second tab page and jump back to the first.

name: git
title: Git status and diff
flow: The staging view lists what changed, Enter opens the diff, s stages the file, and a commit is written without leaving the editor.

name: terminal
title: The terminal pane
flow: A shell in a split, rendered by libghostty: colour output, a git graph, a full-screen program running inside the pane, and a coloured diff.

name: sessions
title: Agent sessions beside the editor
flow: Agent sessions live in panes next to your code: the SESSIONS rail lists them, a new one opens in a split, and the sessions table shows every session with its state, tokens and cost (the session is a recording stand-in; no model runs).

name: lua
title: Scripting in Lua
flow: A dozen lines of Lua add a palette command and a statusline chip; run the file from the palette and both appear at once.

name: jira
title: Jira in a pane
flow: The Jira integration as a tab: issues grouped by status, a row's detail, the second tab, and a filter — here against an offline fake server.

name: marketplace
title: The Marketplace
flow: Integrations install from the Marketplace in the sidebar: browse, press i, and the new pane opens against its (here offline, fake) service.
